approved_choices.label: Operating-company discounted cash flow (FCFF)
approved_choices.basis: Estimate operating cash flows after taxes and reinvestment, discount at the cost of capital, then make the separately reviewed cash, debt and other equity-bridge adjustments. This is the proposed modeling choice based on the operating business, not an Apple-reported fact.

receipt.approved_treatment: Use United States as domicile and USD for both forecast cash flows and the matching discount-rate currency. Use an operating-company FCFF DCF as the primary model, with separately reviewed equity-bridge adjustments. Keep Apple’s products and services visible in the business description. Review exact industry mappings, benchmark versions and weights separately; domicile does not set a US-only country-risk premium.

source_evidence.summary: Apple reports California incorporation and principal offices in Cupertino, California; the country classification is United States.
The filing defines its monetary XBRL unit as USD.
Apple sells devices and related services.
Services include advertising, support, cloud storage, digital content and payment services.
Apple reports geographic operating segments, so US domicile does not mean US-only sales or risk exposure.

receipt.reason: User explicitly approved US domicile, USD valuation currency and the FCFF modeling method.
